dedicated.name: Sarah's Succubus Wings

why_by_stat.DEF%: Sarah scales off DEF and this also helps to give her more bulk and survivability.

dedicated.story:
"A succubus's wings will grow back after they're torn off, but that doesn't mean you should go ripping them off just 'cause you feel like it! Oh, but you, Kris — you're welcome to do what you like with them!"

In a time before Kris's reign as the Ruler of Purgatory, Sarah's beautiful wings were coveted by demons far and wide, to the point that some even attempted to tear them off by force. And every time, Sarah would recoil in disgust and use her powers to give a sound thrashing to any demon who dared to challenge her. She felt like she was on top of the world when Kris appeared, yet Sarah fell for him at once and swore her eternal loyalty to him.

"Come on, Kris... are you sure you don't want my wings? Really?"

lore:
A succubus living in Purgatory. Succubi are high-ranking demonkin who lure adventurers in to drain them of their power and magic.
Sarah is the leader of her coven.
Her strength and beauty are the envy of the other succubi.
She's the one that led Kris to where Rahal was sealed.
She initially approached Kris to laugh at the former noble knight's final struggles, but now she genuinely looks up to him as a commander and potential partner.
She's jealous of Knox, Kris's right-hand man and closest confidante, but has put those differences aside to help Knox in times of need. She's gradually overcoming her greedy and selfish nature as a demonkin to work for the good of others, specifically for Kris and the monster army.
